provider_name: DexPaprika public REST via configured read-only MCP tool
free_access_evidence: Official access documentation is currently conflicted: the DexPaprika per-chain API pages advertise unauthenticated REST endpoints and 50,000 free requests/month per IP without signup; the pricing page advertises a 100,000-credit/month free registered-key tier; the reviewed OpenAPI/rate-limit material previously documented 10,000 credits per IP per rolling 30 days and 15 requests/minute. These are not reconciled into a single allowance. The exact anonymous pool route has prior HTTP 200 evidence, but a later anonymous OHLCV request returned HTTP 402 for exhausted monthly allowance. Do not add a key, register, retry, or use paid hosts.

claims.claim: Free-tier figures served are at most 15 seconds old.
Free REST API maximum data delay is up to 60 seconds.

documented_freshness.handling: Vendor pages conflict; neither claim is assigned to this retained pool response. Preserve returned timestamps and do not infer liquidity/volume observation time.

access.payment: none for free keyless API tier
access.qualification_limit: Official docs and one anonymous no-Authorization request qualify the free route. One further call through the bounded local client verified its route and identity checks. This is one exact pool, not provider-wide qualification; liquidity/volume timestamp scope and independence remain unresolved.

supported_routes.units: liquidity_usd and volume_usd are USD-denominated per docs; reserve is raw token units and must use token decimals
supported_routes.timestamps: Record local retrieved_at_utc separately; retain price_time and last_updated from response; do not assume either stamps liquidity or volume snapshots without source documentation.
supported_routes.caveat: Pool liquidity/TVL is not executable depth; volume is turnover. Upstream lineage relative to DEX Screener remains unknown.
supported_routes.observed_mcp_tool: mcp__dexpaprika__getPoolDetails (response retained separately; do not assume MCP connector billing from REST free-tier docs)
supported_routes.scope: Current client accepts 20-byte hexadecimal EVM addresses on network slugs, plus validated 32-byte Base58 Solana pool/token addresses on Solana. Live qualification evidence remains Ethereum Uniswap V3 USDC/WETH only; Solana support is fixture-tested, not live-qualified.

supported_routes.documented_keyless_scope: One page only; local client limit is 1 to 100 rows. The command defaults to 100 and preserves has_next_page and next_cursor. No automatic pagination.
supported_routes.identity: Each returned row must match the requested network and contain the exact requested token address in detailed tokens[].id; EVM address comparison is case-insensitive and Solana mint comparison is case-sensitive. Pool ID must be valid for the requested network.
supported_routes.timestamps_and_units: Retrieval UTC is recorded. Pool-search rows do not establish a liquidity/volume as-of timestamp; preserve USD fields as returned and do not infer executable depth.
supported_routes.coverage_status: FIRST_PAGE_ONLY when continuation is present; otherwise RESPONSE_PAGE_COMPLETE. Empty results mean no observation, not zero liquidity or volume.
supported_routes.readiness: IMPLEMENTED_FIXTURE_TESTED; no exact-token search live smoke is retained, and current anonymous quota exhaustion prevents live requalification.
supported_routes.independence: UNKNOWN; do not treat as independent corroboration.

supported_routes.task: fallback for exact DEX Screener pair-address snapshot
supported_routes.fallback_scope: Exact pair-address lookup or exact token pool search after DEX Screener no-observation/eligible availability outcome on seven mapped EVM networks or Solana. Token search fetches one page (limit 100) and preserves continuation metadata.
identity: exact requested EVM token ID (case-insensitive) or Solana mint ID (case-sensitive) in detailed tokens[].id
supported_routes.units: Preserve DexPaprika USD liquidity and per-window USD turnover as returned; no capacity inference.
supported_routes.timestamps: Retrieval UTC is recorded; retain provider time fields, but do not assume they stamp liquidity or volume.
supported_routes.read_budget: At most one request to DEX Screener and one request to DexPaprika per command; no retries.
supported_routes.readiness: IMPLEMENTED_FIXTURE_TESTED; exact pool snapshot had prior live response; token-pool search and current live fallback are not live-qualified because current keyless quota is exhausted.
supported_routes.token_search_coverage: One page, limit 100, detailed=true; preserve has_next_page and next_cursor. The official schema documents tokens[].id but describes it as a canonical token ID; require an exact case-insensitive match for EVM contracts or case-sensitive match for Solana mints and fail closed otherwise. Base/quote orientation is not documented and remains UNVERIFIED.

supported_routes.task: bounded historical OHLCV for a specific DEX pool
supported_routes.documented_keyless_scope: No-key plan only: last 24 hours, hourly or coarser (1h, 6h, 12h) intervals; maximum 24 returned candles. Free-key seven-day/10m access is not used.
supported_routes.identity: Request is bound to one network and pool address; candle response has no pool identity envelope, so scope is request-route matched rather than response-verified.
supported_routes.timestamps_and_units: Preserve time_open/time_close and OHLCV fields as returned; retrieval time is recorded separately. Check pool token orientation and quote denomination before interpreting prices as USD.
supported_routes.readiness: IMPLEMENTED_FIXTURE_TESTED; exact anonymous route previously returned HTTP 402 because keyless quota was exhausted. No retry, key, signup, or paid host; live rows remain unavailable.
supported_routes.fallback_scope: Candidate for pool-specific historical replay only; not equivalent to CoinPaprika token-wide daily history and not an automatic fallback for token-wide price series.
supported_routes.independence: UNKNOWN; do not treat as independent corroboration until pool-level upstream collection is established.

request_policy.retry_policy: No automatic retry; on auth, payment, rate-limit, timeout, malformed response, or identity mismatch stop and report the exact state.
prohibited: keyless pool OHLCV windows beyond 24h or intervals finer than 1h
request_policy.documented_keyless_allowance: CONFLICTED: reviewed OpenAPI/rate-limit material states 10,000 credits per IP per rolling 30 days and 15 requests/minute; official per-chain API pages advertise 50,000 free requests/month per IP without signup; official pricing page advertises 100,000 monthly credits for the free registered-key tier. The anonymous client's observed 402 exhaustion is retained; do not assume any advertised ceiling is presently available.
request_policy.runtime_call_gate: The client permits anonymous HTTP only when access.keyless_runtime_status is READY_ZERO_CHARGE_REQUALIFIED. Current status is UNAVAILABLE_KEYLESS_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED. Resume only after a documented quota reset or provider-documented access-state change is recorded and a separately bounded zero-charge requalification succeeds. The MCP connector is a separate billing path and is not an automatic substitute.

independence.rule: Do not count as independent corroboration until pool-level upstream collection distinction is established.
